title: Firewall & Network Security Engineer (all genders)
description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du fühlst dich sowohl in komplexen Netzwerkinfrastrukturen als auch in modernen Firewall- und Security-Umgebungen zuhause? Du möchtest nicht nur Regelwerke administrieren, sondern aktiv zur Sicherheit und Weiterentwicklung geschäftskritischer Netzwerke beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Als Firewall & Network Security Specialist (all genders) betreust du die Netzwerksicherheits- und Firewall-Landschaften unserer eigenen Infrastruktur sowie die unserer Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen und dem Systemhausumfeld. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Netzwerk, Security und Automatisierung, administrierst heterogene Firewall-Umgebungen, unterstützt bei der Absicherung komplexer Netzwerke und sorgst für einen sicheren, performanten und hochverfügbaren Betrieb geschäftskritischer Infrastrukturen.

Die Position kann sowohl in Vollzeit als auch in Teilzeit ausgeübt werden.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Strategie & Architektur: Du konzipierst, planst und implementierst zukunftssichere Firewall-Strategien und Regelwerke entlang strenger Sicherheitsanforderungen.
  • System-Integration & CLI: Du wählst passende Firewall-Hardware sowie -Software aus, konfigurierst diese (gerne auch direkt auf der CLI) und integrierst neue Security-Technologien.
  • Monitoring & Log-Analyse: Du überwachst Firewall-Logs und schließt Systemlandschaften an SIEM-Lösungen (Security Information and Event Management) an.
  • Incident Response & SOC: Du arbeitest eng mit dem SOC und weiteren IT-Teams zusammen, unterstützt bei der Analyse von Sicherheitsvorfällen und bringst deine Expertise in Sicherheitsreviews und Optimierungsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Automatisierung & Linux: Du nutzt deine Linux-Expertise und Skripting-Kenntnisse, um Netzwerk- und Firewall-Prozesse effizient zu automatisieren.
  • Dokumentation & Knowledge: Du pflegst Sicherheitsrichtlinien sowie Konfigurationen sauber und erstellst verständliche Leitfäden für den sicheren Umgang mit Netzwerksicherheitstechnologien.


Das bringst du mit

  • Ausbildung & Fundament: Abgeschlossenes IT-Studium oder eine IT-Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung in der IT-Sicherheit
  • Firewall- & Network-Security: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration und Wartung heterogener Firewall-Systeme führender Hersteller – die Arbeit auf der CLI ist dabei für dich selbstverständlich oder zumindest nicht neu
  • Linux & Automation: Solide Linux-Kenntnisse und idealerweise Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von Netzwerk- oder Firewall-Prozessen (z. B. via Python, Ansible oder Bash)
  • Netzwerk-Know-how: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerktopologien, Routing-Protokollen, VPNs und Segmentierungskonzepten
  • Incident Response & Audits: Praxiserfahrung in Sicherheitsbewertungen, der Analyse sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse sowie idealerweise in der Unterstützung von Incident-Response-Prozessen
  • Zertifizierungen (Bonus): Hersteller-Zertifizierungen im Firewall-Umfeld (z. B. Juniper, Fortinet, 6wind, Sophos) oder ITIL-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber kein MUSS
  • Soft Skills & Arbeitsweise: Starkes analytisches Denken, strukturiertes Troubleshooting und eine kommunikative, teamorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sprachkenntnisse:  Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.

CUREosity ist ein innovatives Med-Tech-Startup aus Düsseldorf, das die Gesundheitsbranche mit Virtual-Reality-Therapien revolutioniert. Unsere mehrfach ausgezeichneten Lösungen verbessern die Rehabilitation für Patient*innen weltweit.

Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft der Rehabilitation zu gestalten?

Deine Mission

  • Du betreust unsere Unternehmens-IT und entwickelst bestehende Systeme und Strukturen gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

  • Du analysierst digitale Geschäftsprozesse und unterstützt dabei, geeignete Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
  • Neue Technologien und IT-Lösungen prüfst du auf ihren Nutzen und begleitest deren Einführung.
  • Bei der Entwicklung interner Softwarelösungen und Automatisierungen bringst du deine technischen Ideen ein.
  • Gemeinsam mit Entwicklung, Support und Operations setzt du bereichsübergreifende IT-Themen um.
  • IT-Projekte übernimmst du eigenständig und bringst sie strukturiert zum Abschluss.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker*in, ein Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im IT-Bereich mit.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits mit Cloud-Technologien und modernen Microsoft-Lösungen wie Microsoft 365, Entra ID oder Azure gearbeitet.
  • Neue Technologien rund um Cloud, KI und Automatisierung wecken dein Interesse.
  • Eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse. Bei uns hast du die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen und zu gestalten. Die „Grüne Wiese“ wartet auf deine Ideen und Initiative. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der Med-Tech-Branche aktiv mit!

Unsere Benefits

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer Unterstützung.
  • Monatlich steuerfreier Sachbezug: Zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits, flexibel einsetzbar.
  • Gesundheits- und Fitnessangebote: Vergünstigter Zugang zu Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten – digital oder vor Ort.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte deine Arbeit so, dass sie zu deinem Leben passt.
  • Tierfreundliches Büro: Hunde sind bei uns herzlich willkommen.

Unsere Werte

Win as a team – Be brave & collaborate: Erfolgreich sind wir nur im Team. Jede*r bringt einzigartige Fähigkeiten mit, und in einer ergebnisorientierten, offenen und kreativen Zusammenarbeit ergänzen wir uns optimal.

Ownership - See the bigger picture and mission: Verantwortung für das eigene Handeln, das Wohl des Teams und des Unternehmens zu übernehmen ist uns wichtig. Probleme sehen wir als Chancen zur Lösung.

Stay Hungry - Take continuous change as a business driver: Stetige Weiterentwicklung und Offenheit für Veränderungen sind unsere Treiber. Kreativer Hunger nach neuen Impulsen ermöglicht uns kontinuierliches Wachstum.

Respekt - Spread positivity - not politics: Offenheit, Positivität und Wertschätzung prägen unsere Interaktionen. Vielfalt in Meinungen und Ideen bereichert unser Team.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

1. Review: Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung und achten besonders auf deine Motivation.

2. Kennenlernen: In zwanglosen Gesprächen – online und vor Ort.

3. Angebot: Bei beidseitigem Interesse freuen wir uns dich bald in unserem Team begrüßen zu dürfen!

Starte jetzt deine Karriere bei CUREosity und verändere mit uns die Gesundheitsbranche!

You will report into the US Enterprise Security Team Lead on our Enterprise Security team in our Global Information Security organization. title: Enterprise Account Executive (EMEA FSP 2)
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
 
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
 
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
 
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
 
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! 

Role Overview 

Magnet Forensics is seeking a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business growth across the  European (excluding United Kingdom and Ireland) forensic service provider market (EMEA FSP 2)
 
This role is focused on building pipeline, acquiring strategic new enterprise customers, and expanding adoption across corporate and private-sector organisations. The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven ability to independently develop territory strategy, create opportunities, and own complex enterprise sales cycles end-to-end using a MEDDPICC-driven sales approach, in addition to handling high volumes of smaller, transactional type sales which involve a rapidly moving sales cycle.
 
As a key member of Magnet Forensics’ EMEA team, you will operate with significant ownership of the EMEA FSP 2 region, working closely with partners located across Europe, marketing, dedicated sales development representative (SDR), sales engineering, and leadership to establish and scale market presence.
 

This role is best suited to candidates motivated by long-term territory development and market ownership rather than short-term account management or inherited revenue.

Candidate must reside in Germany

What You’ll Do

Sales Execution & Territory Ownership

  • Develop and execute a territory plan focused on pipeline creation, new logo acquisition, and predictable revenue growth across the European forensic service provider market.
  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation and close.
  • Maintain strong pipeline coverage aligned to quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Engage executive stakeholders and decision makers within enterprise organizations.

    • MEDDPICC Deal Execution

    • Apply MEDDPICC rigorously to qualify opportunities, access economic buyers, build champions, multithread, and drive forecast accuracy.
    • Navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environments and long sales cycles.
    • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and forecasting practices.

      • Market Expansion

      • Drive market penetration through outbound prospecting, executive networking, and partner collaboration.
      • Acquire new enterprise logos while expanding strategic existing accounts.
      • Identify and develop growth opportunities within key verticals and regulated industries.

        • Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

      • Work closely with regional partners and resellers to generate pipeline and execute joint sales strategies.
      • Enable partners through joint account planning, opportunity alignment, and customer engagement activities.

        • Marketing & Industry Engagement

        • Collaborate with marketing to support regional campaigns, events, and demand generation initiatives. This will sometimes involve collaborating with partners.
        • Represent Magnet Forensics at industry events, conferences, and customer engagements across Europe.

          • Customer Engagement

          • Act as a trusted advisor to customers by understanding investigative, cybersecurity, and digital forensics challenges.
          • Deliver solution-led sales engagements aligned to customer outcomes and business value.

What We’re Looking For
  • 4+ years of enterprise sales experience within SaaS, Cybersecurity, DFIR, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Proven track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and consistently exceeding revenue targets. Demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and executive networking.
  • Experience managing both complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and shorter sales cycles and executive with efficiency and precision.
  • Strong experience applying MEDDPICC (or equivalent) sales methodology.
  • Experience working with both direct and partner-led sales models.
  • Self-starter with the ability to operate independently in a developing region.
  • Comfortable working across international teams and time zones.
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation and executive communication skills.
  • Highly organized with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management practices. Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to territory growth.
  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
  • Meticulous with a strong eye for administrative detail – certain products sold by the EMEA FSP team have a heavily involved approval process where this trait is a must.
    •  

    What Success Looks Like in This Role
  • Build and develop a sustainable enterprise pipeline across the European forensic service provider market through proactive prospecting, partner engagement, and executive relationship development.
  • Establish Magnet Forensics as a trusted investigative technology partner within strategic enterprise accounts.Consistently progress opportunities through structured discovery, value alignment, and MEDDPICC-driven execution.Deliver predictable revenue performance while contributing to long-term regional market growth.

    - Generous time off policies 
    - Competitive compensation 
    - Volunteer opportunities  
    - Reward and recognition programs   
    - Employee committees & resource groups  
     
    Indicators of Success
     
    We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”.  It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”.  We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us. 
     
    How We Work
     
    At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

Det som särskiljer möjligheten är bredden. description: About the role Mission Strengthen Sporty’s offensive security posture by proactively testing and identifying vulnerabilities across our external perimeter, standalone virtual private servers (VPS), physical office infrastructure, and endpoint defenses. The Offensive Security Engineer owns the security testing, continuous perimeter monitoring, and reconnaissance across all Sporty Group external domains, websites, public IP blocks, and DNS configurations. This role works closely with IT, Network Engineering, SOC, and Security teams to convert external discovery, adversary emulation on EDR/XDR systems, and exploitation insights into tuned perimeter controls, firewall rules, and robust defensive guardrails. What you'll be doing Monitor, map, and test Sporty’s entire external attack surface, including all Sporty Group external domains, subdomains, websites, and public IP addresses. Conduct adversary emulation exercises against internal and office endpoints to validate the effectiveness of EDR, XDR, and SOC monitoring platforms. Evaluate the security posture of physical office hardware, corporate network equipment, and internal edge infrastructure. Perform scoped offensive testing on external-facing web applications and limited, public-facing API endpoints. Translate external discovery, DNS security posture, network access control weaknesses, and EDR emulation findings into repeatable defensive checks. Support our Purple Team validate that EDR policies, perimeter controls, firewall rules, and network segmentation work as expected. Document multi-stage network or system exploitation chains to provide practical, reproducible remediation blueprints for infrastructure and SOC teams. Support IT and Network analysts with clear vulnerability descriptions, triage steps, severity logic, and escalation guidance. Improve external asset tracking, perimeter health records, and exposure trend mapping. Track external vulnerability gaps, emulation success rates, remediation times, asset health, and perimeter exposure. What you'll bring Experience in offensive security, perimeter penetration testing, network security assessments, or adversary emulation. Strong understanding of external asset discovery, DNS configuration vulnerabilities, and public IP network routing. Practical experience auditing and testing Linux and Windows environments and underlying network services. Ability to perform adversary emulation and bypass techniques against modern EDR/XDR solutions. Familiarity with testing physical office network hardware, routers, switches, firewalls, and workplace IT systems. Ability to turn external exposures and technical network risks into clear, actionable fixes for IT and Security teams. Experience with core web vulnerabilities and limited, scoped testing of modern API interfaces. Strong scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate perimeter mapping, emulation workflows, and asset discovery. Good understanding of scanning, reconnaissance, and interception tools. Strong documentation skills. Technology Expertise Any of the following: Kali Linux toolset, Nmap, Shodan, Censys, Masscan, Amass, Dig/DNS testing tools, Wireshark, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Python, PowerShell, Bash, VPS environments (Linux/Windows Server OS), Firewalls, Routers, Git, Jira, Confluence What's in it for you Sporty is a remote-first company in pursuit of sustainability A competitive salary plus individual performance-based bonuses every quarter 28 days paid annual leave Core working hours of 10am-3pm in your local time zone, with flexibility outside of these hours Referral bonuses and flash bonuses Top-of-the-line equipment Annual company retreats that provide opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues from around the world Interview Process: Remote video screening with our Talent Acquisition Team Online assessment via Hackerrank Remote video interview with Team Members (60 Mins) Final discussion with the hiring manager (60 mins) If you're interested, we encourage you to apply. title: AI Cybersecurity Engineer (Offensive Security & Threat Modeling)
description: About Us: Where elite tech talent meets world-class opportunities! At Xenon7, we work with leading enterprises and innovative startups on exciting, cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies across various domains of IT including Data, Web, Infrastructure, AI, and many others. Our expertise in IT solutions development and on-demand resources allows us to partner with clients on transformative initiatives, driving innovation and business growth. Whether it's empowering global organizations or collaborating with trailblazing startups, we are committed to delivering advanced, impactful solutions that meet today’s most complex challenges. With a global presence through over 50 branches and correspondents, we serve a diverse and dynamic clientele. As we embark on a groundbreaking digital transformation journey, we are committed to leveraging the latest technologies to establish a state-of-the-art data architecture that will redefine our performance and service delivery. About the Role As a leading financial institution in Egypt, we are heavily investing in localized AI and Machine Learning capabilities to drive innovation while maintaining total data sovereignty. Our Cybersecurity Department is looking for a highly skilled AI Cybersecurity Engineer with a deeply offensive mindset. Operating entirely within our secure, high-performance on-premises infrastructure , you will act as an internal adversary. Your mission is to proactively threat model, simulate advanced cyberattacks (Red Teaming), and manage algorithmic risks to detect and neutralize vulnerabilities in our AI systems before they can be exploited. Key Responsibilities Predictive AI Threat Modeling: Lead advanced threat-modeling exercises across the bank’s localized AI/ML pipelines, data repositories, and training environments. Anticipate sophisticated attacker behaviors to design preemptive security guardrails before models are moved to production. AI Red Teaming & Offensive Simulations: Conduct targeted offensive operations and ethical hacking against our on-premises AI infrastructure. Simulate real-world adversarial attacks, including data poisoning, model inversion, membership inference, evasion attacks, and prompt injection . Framework Mapping with MITRE ATLAS: Implement and operationalize the MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for Artificial-Intelligence Systems) framework. Map identified vulnerabilities to ATLAS tactics and techniques to build a robust, AI-specific defensive matrix aligned with traditional MITRE ATT&CK. On-Premises Infrastructure Hardening: Assess and secure the physical and virtual infrastructure hosting our AI workloads, including bare-metal GPU clusters, local containerized environments (Kubernetes/OpenShift), and private data registries, ensuring strict isolation from external threats. Proactive Risk Management & Early Detection: Collaborate with the SOC and data engineering teams to build predictive detection use-cases and custom alerts. Identify the early warning signs of an AI-targeted attack or data exfiltration attempt before malicious actors can compromise model integrity. Professional Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in Offensive Security, Red Teaming, or Advanced Penetration Testing, with a proven pivot and at least 2 years of hands-on experience securing or attacking AI/ML workloads . Banking Sector Experience (Mandatory): Prior experience working within a regulated financial institution in Egypt. You must understand the security constraints, compliance mandates, and audit rigor required by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) for on-premises operations. Deep Mastery of AI Attack Frameworks: Expert-level knowledge of MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Models (LLMs) . You must have a proven track record of translating these theoretical frameworks into practical, automated offensive playbooks. On-Prem & Core Technical Skills: * Strong proficiency in Python or bash scripting to build custom exploit or testing tools. Deep understanding of on-premises infrastructure components (Linux administration, private networking, storage area networks). Direct experience with container security ( Docker, Kubernetes ) and secure MLOps pipelines. Education & Certifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or a strictly related field. Highly valued offensive certifications: OSCP, OSCE, CRTP, or GPEN , alongside any specialized AI/ML security credentials. Mindset & Communication: A relentlessly curious, adversarial mindset balanced with strong risk management disciplines. The ability to clearly articulate complex, highly technical AI vulnerabilities into actionable remediation plans for data scientists and senior banking executives. Fluency in English.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description: About Linro Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live. We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape. The role You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter. What you will do Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready . Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit. Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run. Support security operations : monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings. Stay close to how the product is actually built . Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side. What we are looking for Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus. Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks. Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level. Careful, structured, and trustworthy. You will handle sensitive material. Nice to have Hands-on Terraform, and experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure. Exposure to a compliance automation platform. Prior general software engineering experience, ideally in the stacks we use day to day (Go, SQL, and cloud infrastructure) How we work We are 100% remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time. What we offer Real ownership of the security and compliance program from the ground up. Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market. A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously. The honest version This is early, we are literally at the start today. You would start from a blank page, not maintain someone else's polished program. That is the appeal if you want to build a security and compliance function from scratch and carry it all the way to real certifications. It is daunting if you are looking for a mature program to step into. We hire at multiple levels, so this can be a first serious role or a senior mandate. Either way, you will own real outcomes fast. description: About ExTrac ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own well-defined features and components end to end within a single system across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built. What the job involves Service design and delivery Build and own features, components, and APIs end to end within a single system, taking responsibility for your work and its place within the overall architecture. Contribute to system design and architecture discussions, and take on more of the design work as you build context and scope. Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions. Help hold services to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, and build the instrumentation to know when they are not meeting them. Build and operate high-throughput data streaming pipelines and work on improving scalability, robustness, and latency. Contribute to the shared foundations other engineers depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, observability, and the environments their work runs in. You should apply if You have built and worked on production backend systems. You will spend your time working on Go and Python services, databases, and APIs, and you know the difference between something that works on a laptop and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost. You can work independently on well-defined problems, and know when to flag ambiguity or ask for input rather than guessing. When the obvious approach fails, you look for another one before escalating. You are happy to take the initiative in order to complete a task, whether that means learning a new skill, reaching out to stakeholders to clarify requirements, or suggesting an alternate approach. You treat quality, security, and observability as engineering fundamentals rather than optional extras, and you flag technical debt rather than letting it accumulate silently. You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you. You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences. Where this role can take you Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means ownership over larger sections of the platform, more architectural say over how our services evolve, and more influence over which problems we take on. Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means service design one month and pipeline or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one. Progression based on impact. Progress by taking on bigger problems. What moves you to Senior here is the scope you can own end to end and the judgement you show when the answer isn't obvious, not time served. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand. 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system. Proficiency in building microservices using Go or Python, with the ability to pick up the other quickly. Practical understanding of software engineering patterns. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable writing clear technical documentation and discussing requirements with colleagues from engineering and the wider team. Interest across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, and security engineering. An interest in how the product is actually used, and a willingness to take analyst feedback into requirements discussions rather than treating requirements as someone else's problem. Desirable Currently working with Go-based microservices. Experience with Elasticsearch and/or PostgreSQL. Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and with the CI/CD pipelines around them. Experience with streaming or event-driven pipelines. Experience with feature flags and trunk-based development. Features land close to weekly, and individual deploys go out several times a day across several projects. Experience working in software for defence, government, or other compliance-constrained environments. Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme. £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays. Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend up to 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office. title: Business Development Representative
description: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. Position Summary: This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America. Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines. League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside. What You'll Own Account research and point of view Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews. Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement. Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot. Outreach and pipeline creation Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls. Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls. Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate. The system itself Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team. Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging. Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record. Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression. Security-related responsibilities: Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities. Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements. Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations. Comply with Information Security Policies. What You'll Bring Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure. A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career. Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers. Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on. Strong written communication. Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it. Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles. Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy. Helpful, not required Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations. Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door. Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents. How You Work Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating: You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you. You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly.. You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack. You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce. You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning. You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on. You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively. You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team. You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you. What Success Looks Like Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves. Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification. The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built. You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living. You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts. CANADA APPLICANTS ONLY: The Canada-specific compensation range below for this full-time position is exclusive of bonus, equity and benefits. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for base salaries for the position across all Canadian locations. The salary range is intentional to account for the performance and career progressions a Leaguer will experience in the role throughout their time at League. Where in the band you may land is determined by job-related skills/experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range specific to your skills and experience during the hiring process. Compensation range for Canada applicants only $55,000—$65,000 CAD AI Fluency & Ways of Working At League, we are an AI-native organization . We expect all employees regardless of role or level to thoughtfully leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. What this means in practice: Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making (e.g., drafting, analysis, coding, research, or process automation) Apply judgment and accountability when using AI by reviewing outputs for accuracy, bias, and quality before use Continuously learn and adapt as new AI tools and capabilities emerge, incorporating them into your ways of working Identify opportunities to improve how work gets done from personal productivity to team-level workflows by leveraging AI effectively Operate with strong data responsibility and security awareness , especially when working with sensitive or regulated information How this scales by level: Individual Contributors: Use AI to improve personal productivity and quality of output Senior ICs / Managers: Integrate AI into team workflows and improve processes Leaders: Drive AI adoption at the organizational level and shape how work is done across teams What we look for: Demonstrated experience using AI tools in a practical, responsible way Curiosity and openness to experimenting with new technologies Ability to balance efficiency with quality and sound judgment Our employees come from different backgrounds, and we celebrate those differences. We are looking for the best candidates for our open roles, but do not expect applicants to meet every qualification in order to be considered. If you are excited about what you could accomplish at League and believe you can add value to our team, we would love to hear from you. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you are an individual in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at recruitinginfo@league.com . Our Application Process: Applying to a role you love can be exhausting, and understanding the next steps can feel vague and uncertain. You have done the hard part of submitting your application; let's do ours by sharing potential next steps You should receive a confirmation email after submitting your application. A recruiter (not a computer) reviews all applications at League. If we see alignment with League's needs, a recruiter will reach out to learn more about your goals. The recruiter will also share the team-specific interview process depending on the roles you are exploring. The final step is an offer, which we hope you will accept! Prior to joining us, we conduct reference and background checks. Additional checks could be required for US Candidates, depending on the role you are exploring. Here are some additional resources to learn more about League: Learn about our platform, leadership team and partners Highmark Health, Google Cloud, League: new digital front door to seamless care Former Providence President and Workday EVP of Corporate Strategy join League Board of Directors League raises $95 million USD in Series C to build world’s leading healthcare CX platform Forbes x League: The Platformization Of Healthcare Is Here Fast Company x League: If we want better innovations in healthtech, we need more competition Work Location: We have a mix of office-centric roles based in our vibrant Toronto office, and remote-eligible roles based anywhere in Canada or US. Each job posting will indicate where the role will be based. Regardless of the role’s posted location, all Toronto-area Leaguers (living within 65 km of our downtown HQ) collaborate in-office Monday through Thursday. Depending on your distance to the office, you’ll enjoy 10 or 20 Flexible Remote Days each quarter for focus and deep-work time. We are committed to fostering a meaningful work environment and connections for all Leaguers regardless of location. Recognize and Avoid Employment scams. Practice safe job searching. Because these tools can interact with employee, user and potentially customer data, you’ll also ensure they are built and deployed properly, with security, maintainability and appropriate engineering standards considered from the outset. This is a role with plenty of autonomy. You’ll own applications end-to-end, from architecture and data model through to UI, deployment, monitoring and ongoing iteration. And when internal priorities allow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your Full Stack skills to our wider product engineering team and the technology behind XYZ Reality’s engineering-grade AR platform. The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, ideally 2–3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work directly with the teams you’ll be building for while retaining flexibility. What You’ll Be Doing Design, build and maintain internal business applications end-to-end, from data model and architecture through to user interface. Take ownership of existing prototypes, dashboards and tools and evolve them into secure, reliable and maintainable applications. Ship quickly using modern serverless and Backend-as-a-Service platforms such as Vercel, Supabase and Firebase. Build applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js and Node.js. Integrate AI capabilities, including LLM APIs, automation and agents, to improve and streamline business workflows. Work directly with stakeholders across XYZ to understand problems, gather requirements and translate business needs into practical technical solutions. Own the full application lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, maintenance and iteration. Ensure appropriate security and data protection standards are built into applications handling employee, user or customer information. Implement authentication, SSO and identity management where required. Champion good engineering practices across code quality, testing, security and CI/CD. Build integrations between internal systems, data sources and third-party platforms. Use feedback and usage data to continually improve the applications you build. Evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities and identify where they can genuinely improve how XYZ operates. Contribute to our wider product engineering environment when capacity allows. What We’re Looking For Demonstrable in-depth professional software engineering experience, ideally within a Full Stack role. Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web development. Hands-on experience with React/Next.js and Node.js. Experience building and deploying applications using platforms such as Vercel, Supabase, Firebase or equivalent modern technologies. Experience owning applications beyond the initial build – including deployment, maintenance, monitoring and ongoing improvement. Comfortable integrating AI/LLM services into applications and using modern AI tooling as part of your development workflow. Experience implementing authentication and identity management, such as OAuth/OIDC, SAML or SSO. A good understanding of application security and how to appropriately handle sensitive business and user data. Strong software engineering fundamentals, with an appreciation for maintainable code, testing and good development practices. Comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning their requirements into effective technical solutions. Able to work autonomously, prioritise effectively and take ownership of the applications you build. Experience within a startup, scale-up or modern technology environment would be particularly valuable, as would experience with Postgres/SQL, row-level security, data visualisation, reporting or workflow automation. title: GRC Pre-Sales Consultant / Solutions Engineer – EMEA
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a Solutions Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted technical voice, guiding customers toward clarity, feasibility, and alignment on the end-to-end solution. Because Vanta is the platform our customers rely on to build and run their GRC programmes, this is a natural next step for GRC professionals, programme managers, auditors, and compliance practitioners who want to apply their domain expertise in a strategic, customer-facing pre-sales role. You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success. This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on. What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta: Serve as a strategic sales partner, owning the technical relationship with prospects and customers. Strategic Discovery and Deal Qualification: Partner with Account Executives to uncover technical, operational, and business pain points, validating use cases and aligning solutions to measurable customer impact and urgency. Secure the Solution Win and Alignment: Validate technical feasibility, drive clarity on success criteria, and guide stakeholders toward a shared vision for the end-to-end solution (The Solution Win: Desirable, Viable, and Aligned). High-Impact Technical Validation: Deliver tailored, narrative-driven demonstrations that showcase how Vanta solves the customer's specific problem, including how Vanta automates and operationalises their GRC programmes across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures. Solution Strategy and Deal Shaping: Partner with the Account Executive to align the customer's success criteria with Vanta's unique strengths, proactively surface technical risks, and propose clear pathways to ensure focused deal progression and mutual success. Post-Sale Handoff and Continuity: Ensure a seamless transition to the post-sales team by creating and completing a handoff document that captures the finalised solution design, expectations, and any known risks or constraints. Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as a trusted technical voice, listening carefully to customers to provide structured market feedback to the Product team to prioritise functionality and drive sales opportunities. Support customers throughout their trial process with Vanta. Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement. How to be successful in this role: Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday). Have 5+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, GRC consultant, or equivalent customer-facing role, including previous B2B SaaS experience. Strategic Problem Solver: Possess deep technical proficiency to identify and validate technical, operational, and business pain points, driving clarity on solution requirements (Viable Solution Win). Exceptional Communicator: Exhibit outstanding communication, storytelling, and active listening abilities, capable of delivering tailored, high-impact demonstrations that reinforce the sales narrative (Command of the Message). Customer-Centric Advocate: Lead with empathy and curiosity, focusing on strategic discovery to uncover the why and urgency behind customer needs and tying every technical detail to measurable buyer impact (Desirable Solution Win). Collaborative Deal Shaper: Work in lockstep with Account Executives on deal strategy, proactively strengthening qualification and guiding stakeholders toward alignment on a clear delivery path (Aligned Solution Win). Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture. Be detail-oriented and organised, with strong project management skills. Have general knowledge with a scripting language (Python, Ruby, Bash, and JavaScript) and a desire to expand those skills. Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus. Ideally have prior experience in the cybersecurity, GRC (governance, risk, and compliance), or audit space. Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. <p>Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Participate in<a </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Experience building and maintaining backend applications with Ruby on Rails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering and maintaining software systems as part of a larger engineering team.</p> </li> <li> <p>The ability to investigate technical problems, ask for context when needed, and work toward a practical resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear communication and collaboration skills in a distributed team.</p> </li> <li> <p>An interest in learning from others, sharing knowledge, and growing your technical skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Frontend development experience, including JavaScript or Vue.js, is helpful.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass). title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time. Key responsibilities: Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand. Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools. Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration). Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself. Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating. Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling. Your background: A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work. Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration. Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast. Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required. A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet. A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human). You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners). You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners). You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple). KPIs & Success Measures Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings. Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet. Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support. Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews. Benefits: 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees Flexible working hours Deep Dive About Pencil Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI. We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past. Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500. https://www.trypencil.com About The Brandtech Group The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology. It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022. Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever. In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund). The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns. https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
