title: IT System Administrator
description: We are looking for an expert and committed IT System Administrator to oversee, develop and maintain our company’s IT systems. To be successful, you are highly knowledgeable in Azure cloud infrastructure, cyber security, Identity Access Management, application administration, and automation. You will manage and ensure efficient, secure operation of our Information Systems. Duties and Responsibilities : • Manage and ensure the efficient operation of our Microsoft Windows and Linux servers, network, hardware and software systems, including extensive oversight of our Azure cloud infrastructure. • Troubleshoot and resolve IT systems issues, including network configurations, server performance, and cloud resources. • Provide first, second- and third-level IT support to employees, ensuring prompt and effective resolution of technical issues. • Manage and administer Microsoft Entra ID to ensure compliance with security, identity, and governance standards. • Collaborate with IT teams to design, deploy and upgrade Azure cloud solutions that meet company’s operational needs. • Document, manage, maintain and improve the Azure cloud architecture and IT processes. • Implement and oversee security protocols to protect company data and ensure compliance. • Participate in IT-related projects as required and maintain up‑to‑date IT documentation. Work Experience and Education requirements : • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent, 5 to 7 years of experience. • Proven experience in similar position. • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Windows Server, and Microsoft 365; certification a plus. • Strong background in cybersecurity, ensuring the highest levels of protection across the organization. • High proficiency on IAM (Identify Access Management) platforms. • Proven experience in creating scripts in Python or PowerShell to automate repetitive operations. • Knowledgeable with Jira and Confluence Atlassian solutions. • Knowledgeable with Google Workspace. • At ease with Generative AI tools (including prompt engineering, AI-assisted debugging). • Familiar with Database administration (MS-SQL). • Familiar with cloud business applications (CRM, ERP), Box for support and user administration Knowledge, Skills & Abilities required: • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize a diverse workload. • Flexible, agile mindset, service oriented, customer-focused, results-focused. • Fluent in English and good level of French is mandatory. • Effective written and oral communication skills

title: Cloud Engineer (AWS) Full Time - Remote EU
description: About Us Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare. Job Description We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our team, where you will play a critical role in optimizing our cloud infrastructure to meet our customers’ needs. This position is pivotal to our mission of providing a seamless, secure, and scalable experience on our platform Key Responsibilities Enhance and maintain highly available, secure, and scalable AWS cloud environments and services. Manage and prioritize tasks in the cloud infrastructure backlog to address immediate needs and plan long-term improvements. Set up infrastructure monitoring and observability solutions, proactively addressing availability, performance or security issues. Learn the current infrastructure and take ownership of day to day cloud operational tasks and activities. Assess new technologies, systems, and services for production readiness, ensuring seamless and stable integration. Prepare and maintain documentation on cloud processes, procedures, and architectures to ensure clear understanding and team-wide knowledge. Apply AWS Well-Architected Framework principles to evaluate and optimize our current infrastructure. Contribute in out of office hour cloud deployments once or twice a month Conduct POCs (proof of concepts) on new AWS services, third-party tools, and technologies to drive continuous improvement in our infrastructure. A demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving. A university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 3-5 years of hands-on experience with AWS cloud services in a professional setting. Proficiency with core AWS services, including IAM, S3, KMS, RDS, VPC, ECS, EC2, and more. Experience working with multi-account and multi-region AWS production environment setups and using IaaC to manage them. Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, preferably Terraform. Scripting experience with one or more languages, such as Python, Bash, or Node.js. Good knowledge of cloud security principles and services, such as AWS WAF, GuardDuty, Config and CloudTrail. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools preferably GitLab Experience with software version control and Git. Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts, including VPC, VPC Peering, Subnets, and Load Balancing. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools for cloud environments, such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenSearch, and the ELK stack. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to challenges. A genuine interest in staying updated with new AWS services and features, integrating advancements into the cloud environment. Ability to work well in a flexible, startup environment, taking initiative to establish new processes when necessary. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Good listening skills. Familiarity with industry best practices in cloud architecture principles. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team setting. Availability to work during Central European Time (CET) business hours.

title: Platform Engineer
description: About us Regulatory submissions that take months. Deviation reports that pile up on QA desks. Pharmaceutical teams spending their best hours os documentation instead of science. We are building the AI systems that change this. Visium is an enterprise AI company with deep roots in life sciences. Our two products, Scribe and Devin, are purpose-built for pharma teams operating in GxP-regulated environments, and are gaining traction with leading life sciences organizations across Europe. Scribe automates the drafting of regulatory documents, keeping human experts in control at every step. Devin handles deviation management end to end, from event capture to root cause analysis and corrective action generation. We are now building the team that takes these products further. If you want to work on AI that genuinely matters, this is the role. Role You will build and own the platform that makes Visium's products reliable, scalable, and secure across every customer environment we operate in. Our deployment model requires running software inside customer cloud tenants, which means you will be managing infrastructure across multiple regulated environments simultaneously, each with its own compliance and data residency requirements. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will work closely with the engineering team to build the core infrastructure abstractions everyone relies on, set reliability standards, and make sure we can scale without breaking things. Key Responsibilities: Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure across Azure (primary) and AWS using Pulumi and Terraform Build and manage container orchestration environments for our agentic AI services, data pipelines, and API backends Architect and maintain our dual-deployment SaaS model, enabling secure, isolated deployments within customer cloud tenants Implement and enforce security controls, data residency requirements, and audit trail infrastructure aligned with GxP and SOC 2 requirements Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that allow the engineering team to ship reliably and safely Set up and own observability: monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing across all environments Contribute to incident response and lead post-incident learning Build developer-friendly infrastructure abstractions that reduce friction and improve engineering velocity You are a backend engineer at heart who has gone deep on infrastructure and platform work, and thrives in environments where the stakes are high and the problems are real: Strong software engineering background, ideally in backend systems, with deep infrastructure and platform know-how built on top of it Hands-on experience with Azure (required) and AWS Proficient with Pulumi (preferred) or Terraform for infrastructure as code Strong Kubernetes experience: deployment, scaling, observability, and reliability Solid understanding of cloud networking, IAM, and security best practices Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Comfortable with Python and scripting for automation Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar Autonomous, proactive, and serious about reliability Nice to have Experience deploying software within customer cloud tenants or managed application patterns Familiarity with GxP, SOC 2, HIPAA, or other regulated industry compliance requirements Experience with multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure Pulumi experience specifically We know that great candidates might not check every box. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could contribute, we’d love to hear from you.

title: C005157 Cyber Security Officer (CTS) - MON 24 Aug
description: Deadline Date: Monday 24 August 2026 Requirement: Cyber Security Officer Location: Ramstein, DE Full Time On-Site: Yes Time On-Site: 100% Total Scope of the request (hours): 420 Required Start Date: 1 October 2026 End Contract Date: 31 December 2026 Required Security Clearance: NATO COSMIC TOP SECRET Duties & Role: In support of CSU Ramstein's mission, the individual is responsible to develop effective, agile and resilient cyber security solutions tailored to specific operational requirements and environmental conditions. Incumbent will consult with stakeholders to evaluate functional requirements and translate functional requirements into technical solutions. Will design, develop, test, and evaluate information system security throughout the systems development life cycle and are responsible for the analysis and development of the integration, testing, operations, and maintenance of systems security. Key Duties will include: Applies and maintains specific security controls as required by organisational policy and local risk assessments. Communicates security risks and issues to business managers and others. Performs basic risk assessments for small information systems. Contributes to the identification of risks that arise from potential technical solution architectures. Suggests alternate solutions or countermeasures to mitigate risks. Defines secure systems configurations in compliance with intended architectures. Supports investigation of suspected attacks and security breaches. Leads a team of 3-4 Cyber Security and COMSEC personnel through day-to-day operations Responsible as the Cyber Security Section Head for the administration of all aspects of Cyber Security activities in coordination with the NATO Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), to include, but not limited to, boundary protection management, data loss prevention and enterprise antimalware. Schedule, coordinate and facilitate security audits and inspections, manage post inspection actions. Supervises monitoring, testing, evaluating computer security systems and the evaluation of Cyber Security aspects of CIS Accreditation. Plans and as necessary implements Cyber Security services in support of Agency SLs, DSO, Strat and other Agency organizational elements as applicable. Deputise for higher grade staff as required. Performs other duties as required. Specific Working Conditions: The mandatory working time shall be 38 hours per week, to be performed Monday to Friday. A daily unpaid lunch break shall be taken in accordance with local regulations and Agency practices. The Contractor shall maintain personal liability and comprehensive insurance coverage for the duration of the contract. Work may be performed on-site at the designated location and/or remotely, in accordance with project requirements and subject to prior approval by the Agency. The Contractor shall ensure reliable communication, availability during agreed working hours, and secure access to all required Agency systems, networks, and documentation platforms, in compliance with applicable security, information assurance, and data protection policies. Skills, Knowledge & Experience: Security clearance (COSMIC TOP SECRET-ATOMAL, CTS-A), provided by the national security organization valid and available at the time of submission of the bid and covering the period of the contract (CTS in process will not be accepted) Minimum of 5 yrs of experience in Windows Server security hardening, incl. implementation of security baselines, policy enforcement, vulnerability mitigation, and system compliance; At least 3 yrs of experience with Trellix ePolicy Orchestrato, Trellix Endpoint Security, incl. Trellix Data Loss Prevention and Trellix Application Control (or equivalent security software), 2 yrs experience with system security, security architecture, network security engineering, security governance, and risk management Detailed knowledge and working experience of security and networking technologies incl. IPv4, Software based Firewalls, VPNs, Intrusion Detection and Forensic tools Practical experience: Wireless LAN technologies and endpoint security of mobile devices including laptops, tablets and smartphones; Security incident handling, interpretation of Cyber Security audit results and conducting risk assessments; Identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities; Supporting NATO Enterprise CIS, knowledge of NATO responsibilities and organization, incl. the NATO Command Structure, ACO & ACT and knowledge of NATO Security Policy and supporting directives. CISM or CISSP Certification Bachelor's degree at a nationally certified University in a related discipline and 2 years post-related experience. Exceptionally, demonstration of a candidate's particular abilities or experience combined with at least 6 years extensive and progressive expertise in duties related to the function of the post. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously; Demonstrated ability to handle stressful situations with calmness, ensuring the user feels supported throughout their interaction. Empathetic and patient, understanding the frustrations users may feel and aiming to alleviate them. Positive attitude and a genuine desire to assist and educate user. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical information in a user-friendly manner. Strong analytical skills, capable of quickly identifying issues and determining the most efficient resolution. Level 3 English language skills IAW NATO STANAG 6001: 3333 or according to Common European Framework of Reference for Language level B2-C1/Upper Intermediate-Advanced level Knowledge and working experience: Palo Alto Enterprise firewalls, Public Key Infrastructure, McAfee Endpoint Security Enterprise solutions. Knowledge and experience with Windows Server 2022, 2019, 2016, and Windows 11, Windows 10 operating system environments. Experience in managing centralized endpoint security (i.e. AV, DLP, Application Control, Drive encryption) solutions, (Trellix) and using Vulnerability Scanners (Nessus). Knowledge and experience in server, network and storage virtualization technologies (VMware vSphere, ESX, NSX and vSAN). Fundamental knowledge of cloud technologies Familiarity with ITIL or other IT service management frameworks(incident, request fulfilment, problem, change and capacity management) Basic understanding of Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) concepts (i.e. RPO, RTO, MTTR, MTBF) and approaches (active-active, active-passive) Prior experience of working in an international environment comprising both military and civilian elements TRG and CERT: CGRC/CAP or CASP+ (or Cloud+, PenTest+, Security+, GSEC or equivalent certification) ITIL (v3 or v4) Foundation certified 0731 NATO COMPUSEC Practitioner Level 1, 0732 NATO COMPUSEC Practitioner Level 2 0280 NATO CIS Security Officer Security Professional certification: CISM or CISSP or CISSO or CPTE or CySA+ or FITSP-A or GCSA or CISA or CISSP or CISSP-ISSEP or GSLC or GSNA; (CEH, GIAC, ISC2, or other relevant certification) Can support physical task requirements with the ability to lift up to 25 lbs.

title: Founders Associate
description: You will be responsible for the core operations of our company in the areas of finance, people & culture, recruitment, and compliance. Your job is to turn founder attention into leverage: keep these topics running reliably, and making sure akeno stays compliant, financially transparent, and a place people want to join. The structures, tools, and processes are already in place. We value your ability to take full responsibility for them and, above all, to ensure their reliability. This means running them week after week, adapting them where they no longer fit, and being accountable for the results. For us, compliance is a genuine business issue, not just a box to check. We sell software to large manufacturing companies, which means that nearly every deal involves security reviews, data protection questions, and audit requirements. With your help, answering these questions comes easy. This is a hands-on role within a growing team. Strategic thinking and meticulous day-to-day execution are equally part of the job - often even within the same week. You’ll work directly with our founders. What You'll Do Own and run our financial reporting incl. accounting in Moss and some other tools. Make sure all relevant documents and invoices reach our tax advisor on time and error-free. Own the HR infrastructure end to end: Personio, policies, contracts, handbook, and legal compliance. Run our onboarding and offboarding cycles and act as the main internal contact for people topics. Own hiring needs together with leadership, and support the full recruiting lifecycle from job description to signed contract. Keep our recruiting pipelines active and our ATS (Workable) clean. Source, screen, and engage candidates through the channels you own. Own our compliance landscape across data protection, information security, and employment law, including the documentation enterprise deals depend on. Maintain our ISMS (Kertos). Refine any of the above where the current process no longer fits, and automate repetitive work rather than absorbing it. Must-haves 3+ years of professional experience combining operational execution with process ownership, for example in finance, people operations, compliance, consulting, or a founder-adjacent startup role. Track record of taking over existing processes and running them reliably, including under time pressure and with incomplete handover. Solid working knowledge of financial compliance and reporting requirements. Solid working knowledge of HR compliance and German labor law. Working knowledge of GDPR and information security requirements, plus the ability to get up to speed quickly on frameworks you have not worked with yet. Comfortable reading contracts and knowing when to escalate to external counsel. Experience in recruiting or talent sourcing, ideally for technical roles. Confident with tooling across finance, HR, recruiting, and compliance (e.g. Moss, Personio, Workable) and quick to automate repetitive work. Strong stakeholder communication and the confidence to make decisions independently, including saying no. Comfortable owning both the long-term structure and the tedious daily tasks that keep it running. Fluent German and English. Nice-to-haves Experience owning these functions in a company of similar size and stage. Experience maintaining an ISO 27001, SOC 2, or comparable certification through recertification or surveillance audits. Experience working with tax advisors, legal counsel, or investors on reporting and compliance topics. Experience hiring engineers or other technical profiles. Familiarity with data tooling or scripting to keep reporting and automations running yourself.

title: Technical Application Engineer
description: Do you enjoy taking ownership of complex technical environments? Do you like combining infrastructure, security and automation to keep mission-critical SaaS platforms? Then join the team behind Benefits-Plaza, Keylane's all-in-one Employee Benefits platform that connects employers, insurers and payroll providers across the Netherlands. As a Technical Application Engineer within our Technical Application Management (TAM) team, you are responsible for the availability, performance, security and continuous improvement of the Benefits-Plaza platform. You'll work closely with experienced engineers and act as a technical expert for one of our most important SaaS solutions. This is a hands-on role where infrastructure, middleware, security and automation come together. You'll regularly balance operational continuity, customer expectations and security requirements while making sound technical decisions under pressure. You'll be responsible for: Drive the resolution of complex platform incidents and problems, ensuring timely recovery while acting as the technical escalation point for internal teams and stakeholders. Monitor the Benefits-Plaza platform and proactively resolve operational issues, including resource bottlenecks, application outages and middleware failures (e.g. disk space, CPU usage and Tomcat availability). Contribute to daily operations: handling service requests and standard changes, following agreed ITIL processes. Managing service requests and standard changes in line with ITIL processes. Managing web service integrations, including networking, whitelisting, security configuration and end-to-end technical validation. Planning and executing maintenance activities, including patching and upgrading technologies such as RHEL, DB2, Tomcat and related components. Managing the lifecycle of client and server certificates, coordinating renewals and secure deployments. Lead the technical execution of external audits, penetration tests and disaster recovery exercises by preparing technical evidence, coordinating activities and driving remediation where needed. Driving automation and standardization by improving runbooks, scripts and operational tooling. Optimizing monitoring, capacity management and operational dashboards to improve platform reliability. Key about your team You'll be part of Keylane's Technical Application Management (TAM) organization, where we ensure our business-critical SaaS platforms are secure, stable and always available for our customers. Together, we: Deliver best-in-class SaaS services from a secure, ISO-certified private cloud, ensuring our customers can focus on pension administration while we manage the technical platform. The team consists of highly skilled IT professionals with strong expertise in infrastructure, databases, middleware and security, combined with deep knowledge of the Life & Pension domain. Work with standardized processes for migrations, implementations and operations, and continuously refine our way of working based on experience and feedback. Foster a collaborative culture where ownership, innovation and continuous learning are encouraged, and everyone has the opportunity to make an impact. You recognize yourself in the following profile: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or a related technical field. You have 5+ years of experience in technical application management, infrastructure operations or a similar role managing business-critical applications. You are experienced in managing application servers such as Apache Tomcat and have a solid understanding of their interaction with networking, security and the application stack layer. You have practical experience with security hardening, patching and vulnerability management, especially in regulated or audited environments. You are familiar with certificates (PKI), networking and firewalls, and know how to work with concepts like whitelisting, proxies and load balancers. You can script and automate (for example with PowerShell, Bash or Ansible) and are comfortable working with monitoring and deployment tools. You are analytical, structured and pragmatic, able to quickly understand complex situations and define clear next steps. You are a communicative team player: You work closely with colleagues and stakeholders and can translate technical issues into business impact. You like working in a dynamic, fast-growing environment and think in solutions. Experience with Oracle, WebLogic and Windows Server is considered a plus. You will grow into taking more ownership of incidents and changes, and after a proper onboarding and training period, you will be part of the standby/on-call rotation. Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously. A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and reference check are part of the application process. All employees follow information security training and have basic information security responsibilities .

title: 2026-0083 Cyber Operations Mgmt System Demonstration (NS) - FRI 21 Aug RELAUNCH
description: Updates are highlighted in bold and underlined in the SOW. Bidding instructions are now included in the SOW, so a technical proposal is expected for this RFQ, not only CVs. Initial submitted bids can be resubmitted together with the now required technical proposal. BIDDING INSTRUCTIONS Price Quote: The Bidder shall submit a quote in accordance with the NTE provided in the Project Overview on page 1. Technical Quote: Bidders shall submit a proposal clearly providing the following information: a. The proposed approach to address the required scope of work and the defined deliverables. The proposed approach should address at the minimum: i. Sufficient details to allow assessment of the bidder’s understanding of the requirements; ii. Previous similar experience; and iii. Relevant experience of the proposed personnel. b. CV(s) and attestation(s) of the assigned personnel for the project. Deadline Date: Friday 21 August 2026 (was Wednesday 19 August 2026) Requirement: Cyber Operations Management System (COMS) Demonstration Location: Offsite Note: Please refer to your Subcontract Agreement, article 6.4.1.a, which states “Off-Site Discount: 5% (this discount is applicable to all requirements, and applies when the assigned personnel are permitted to work Off-Site, such as at- home)". Please be sure to price this discount in your overall price proposal when submitting bids against off-site RFQs Period of Performance: EDC + 4 months. Estimated start date: 1 September 2026 (tentative) Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET SECTION 1 – INTRODUCTION 1.1 Background The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) is dedicated to acquiring, deploying, and defending communication systems for NATO's political decision-makers and Commands. It operates on the frontlines against cyber-attacks, collaborating closely with governments and industry to prevent future debilitating attacks. The NCI Agency plays a crucial role in maintaining NATO's technological edge and ensuring the collective defence and crisis management capabilities of the Alliance. In pursuit of this mission, NCIA requires specialized advisory services to enhance its interim workforce capacity. The Cyber Operations Management System (COMS) demonstration is a high priority task which aims at: Building a mock-up environment on the NATO Software Factory to obtain a functionally equivalent environment to the operational version of Cyber Operations Management System (COMS) today. Capturing the requirements and demonstrating to industry the functionalities of the current capabilities by demonstrating on the mock-up environment. COMS operates on the NCSC NROP and NCSC NSOP CIS and is accessible from NATO-wide stakeholders from their respective low-side and high-side environments. COMS supports Cyber Incident Response and Defensive Cyber Operations and is therefore a critical component of the NATO Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) today and the NATO Integrated Cyber Defence Centre (NICC) tomorrow. 1.2 Scope of Work The purpose of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to acquire contractor support to build a mock-up environment of the current COMS NR and COMS NS. Based on the mock-up of the environment, the contractor shall identify and capture the requirements of what COMS is able to deliver today in a video demo to be presented at a planned industry engagement day. SECTION 2 – PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS 2.1 Deliverable D1: Mock-up of COMS NR/NS Environment on the NATO Software Factory The contractor shall build a mock-up environment that simulates what is doable today on COMS NR and COMS NS, including the relation between Atlassian JIRA, Atlassian Confluence, and all plugins currently installed on the production environment. It will notably replicate all Jira processes supporting the execution of the DEFEND branch missions, as well as all other supporting Jira processes (including but not limited to 'STAGIL assets' projects). It will also replicate the mechanism allowing low-side workflows tracking from the high-side with the associated hand-over/take-over mechanism, the dynamic wiki page publications based on Jira issues changes, and the use of dynamic page templates (scaffolding/reporting-based). Acceptance Criteria D1 All existing processes at the first day of Contract Award on COMS (Jira) NR and COMS (Jira) NS have a functional equivalent process on the mock-up environment. All data-types used for any of these processes have corresponding mock-up data implemented that will allow at least 10 different instances of each process to be run without using the same data twice. Any Confluence space and pages used in support of these processes must also exist on the mock-up environment, including dynamic elements, labelling, and all plugins as on production. The simulation of the Data diode and the replication mechanism must be implemented. Due Date: 60 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 40% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed Delivery Acceptance Sheet (DAS). 2.2 Deliverable D2: Identification and Documentation of the COMS Requirements Based on the mock-up environment established in D1, the contractor shall identify and capture the functional and non-functional requirements of what COMS is able to deliver today into a NATO AQAP conforming format that is readable and unambiguously understandable by a third-party company having no prior knowledge of NCSC, NCIA, or NATO. The requirements shall be organized in logical groups to facilitate the production of a video in D3. The requirements shall be written such that a third party could recreate, using one or multiple technical capabilities, a solution that would satisfy the identified requirements. The requirements will be captured within the COMS Confluence environment until final review is agreed. The final deliverable will be in Word document format. Acceptance Criteria D2 The requirements shall meet the following principles: each requirement must be unique, testable, verifiable, unambiguous, traceable and necessary in accordance to the relevant NATO AQAP. Due Date: 45 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 20% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed DAS. 2.3 Deliverable D3: Creation of a Video Demonstrating the Identified Requirements in D2 The contractor shall produce a recorded video introducing what COMS is today, and going through the different requirements captured in D2. The requirements document shall identify the timestamp in the video at which each requirement is being presented. The video in D3 and the requirements in D2 will be made available to industry as part of pre-solicitation industry engagements. The video shall be securely hosted by the contractor. A copy shall be delivered to NCIA. The video shall remain available on the contractor-hosted platform, and as per D4, for a duration of contract end plus 2 months. Acceptance Criteria D3 The video shall be endorsed by NCIA. Minimum resolution: 1920x1080p using H.264/AVC encoding. Supporting audio shall be a minimum of 44 kHz. The voice explaining the content of the video must be from a person having STANAG 6001 Speaking skills of level 4 minimum or from an English native speaker. The content of the material shall meet or exceed ISO 40180, and cover all requirements identified and endorsed in D2. Due Date: 70 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 20% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed DAS. 2.4 Deliverable D4: Demonstration of the COMS Mock-up Environment The contractor shall present a live demo of the COMS mock-up environment as part of an industry engagement day organized by NCIA. The demo will take place online. The live demo shall cover the points of the video in D3, with an authorized level of interaction (questions from industry). The Q&A session may be organized at the end of or during the demo, as best determined by the contractor. NCIA is responsible for inviting industry and setting the date of the demo. The contractor shall ensure availability and full working condition of the environment at the time of the demo. Depending on the risk of non-availability, an alternate date may be set by common agreement between NCIA and the contractor. NCIA will be present during the demo to answer questions. Acceptance Criteria D4 The live-demo occurred and all invited industry members who expressed their confirmation to attend have been able to attend. No disruption of video, audio of more than 5 seconds or dropping connection for participants caused by the contractor have happened. Due Date: 100 days from Base Period EDC Payment Milestone: 20% of contract value. After deliverable completion and signed DAS. SECTION 3 – CONTRACTOR QUALIFICATIONS 3.1 Contractor Experience [See Requirements] 3.2 Personnel Requirements The Contractor shall determine and provide the appropriate number and composition of personnel — possessing the necessary qualifications, skills, and experience — to successfully fulfil all requirements of this effort, taking into consideration the very tight delivery timeline. NCIA expects 3 persons to work on this SOW to meet the deadlines. The Contractor shall ensure that the proposed team is capable of delivering high-quality, timely, and fully compliant deliverables as specified in this SOW. Only the company's project manager must hold a NATO SECRET security clearance, necessary to access the production environment. Other contractor staff must be authorized at NATO RESTRICTED level. The work shall be executed fully at the contractor's facilities. SECTION 4 – PROJECT MILESTONES AND DELIVERABLES Deliverable D1: Mock-up of COMS NR/NS environment on the NATO Software Factory. Due: 60 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 40% of contract value. Deliverable D2: Identification and documentation of the COMS requirements. Due: 45 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 20% of contract value. Deliverable D3: Creation of a video demonstrating the identified requirements in D2. Due: 70 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 20% of contract value. Deliverable D4: Demonstration to selected industry members of the COMS mock-up environment. Due: 100 days from Base Period EDC. Payment: 20% of contract value. Payment is dependent upon successful acceptance of each deliverable and the signed Delivery Acceptance Sheet (DAS). Invoices shall be accompanied by the DAS, signed by the contractor and the NCIA POC. SECTION 5 – COORDINATION AND REPORTING Reporting mechanisms will be defined during the kick-off meeting. SECTION 6 – SCHEDULE The Task Order will be effective immediately after contract signature. The estimated starting date is 15 July 2026 (tentative), with a period of performance of EDC + 4 months. SECTION 7 – TRAVEL There is no travel expected. Exceptionally, if any travel is required, costs are considered to be included in the overall contract price and will not be reimbursed separately. SECTION 8 – PURCHASER-FURNISHED INFORMATION AND RESOURCES NCIA to fund the access to the NATO Software Factory. NCIA to deliver the laptops necessary to access the NATO Software Factory (maximum 3 laptops). NCIA to provide technical support (1 hour per working day) to assist the contractor in delivering on scope, time, schedule, and expected quality. 3. CONTRACTOR QUALIFICATIONS Required Experience and Skills Excellent knowledge (5+ years) of Atlassian JIRA Datacenter administration. Excellent knowledge (5+ years) of Atlassian Confluence Datacenter administration. Prior experience working on the NCIA COMS Environment. Excellent knowledge in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation and customization tasks. Excellent knowledge in deploying solutions on Microsoft Azure environments. Excellent knowledge of Java, Groovy, and ScriptRunner. Strong experience in dynamic content management and integration between Atlassian JIRA and Confluence. Strong experience in managing metadata in Atlassian Confluence, Office and PDF documents, and Microsoft SharePoint. Strong understanding of the inner workings of Atlassian JIRA and Confluence instances, including at database level. Experience with the management of Linux servers (preferably RedHat). NATO SECRET security clearance required for the project manager. NATO RESTRICTED authorization required for all other contractor personnel.

title: Consultant Release Management
description: At Keylane, we are looking for a Consultant Release Management to strengthen our Release Management department. In this role, you ensure that changes to our software are delivered to our customers in a controlled and predictable manner. Key About Your Role As a Consultant for Release Management, you are a key link between our internal departments and our customers. You consistently ensure stable, predictable, and high-quality releases across all environments. You will combine operational release coordination with continuous improvement of release processes, helping Keylane move towards one standardized way of releasing for all customers. Key About Your Team You will be part of the Release Management department, a team of driven and experienced colleagues. The team consists of diverse expertise (pension, actuarial, technical) and works closely with colleagues in the Netherlands, Denmark, and India, each bringing their own strengths. Check out our blog posts and videos to see what it is like to work at Keylane Key About Your Responsibilities Work closely with several internal departments to support customers with releases. Troubleshoot, analyze, and help resolve issues related to releases and deployments. Coordinate internal and external stakeholders around releases on both test and production environments. Ensure smooth planning, communication, and execution of releases. Collaborate with internal teams to integrate new features and enhancements into controlled releases. Contribute to the development of standardized release processes across customers and products. Ensure work procedures, documentation, and runbooks are accurate, clear, and up to date. Able to work in Dutch is a plus. * A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and reference check are part of the application process. *Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply

title: Security Engineer
description: Job Summary Our company is developing a cutting-edge wireless communication system to connect multiple portable devices. Long range, high data rates, low latency, resistance to interferences, and multipath make this problem particularly challenging, giving the candidate unique opportunities to research, design, and implement the next-generation radio communication systems. The Security Engineer will be part of the Information Security team and will play a key role in strengthening KRUSH Labs’ technical security capabilities. This role will work closely with IT and R&D to translate security risks, requirements, and audit findings into effective technical controls and sustainable security practices. We are looking for a hands-on, experienced security professional who can independently drive security improvements, challenge weak practices, and contribute to developing a pragmatic security function aligned with business needs. Key Responsibilities Work as part of the Information Security team and closely collaborate with IT and other stakeholders to strengthen the company’s technical security capabilities and support the implementation of the information security program. Translate security risks, audit findings, compliance requirements, and management priorities into practical technical remediation actions, implementation plans, and measurable security improvements. Deploy, configure, and operationalize SIEM capabilities, including log source onboarding, data connector configuration, detection use case development, alert tuning, dashboards, workbooks, and operational handover. Support vulnerability management, patching, secure configuration, hardening activities, and technical control implementation across IT infrastructure, endpoints, cloud services, and relevant business systems. Develop and maintain automation, scripts, queries, and technical integrations using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, or similar technologies to improve security operations and reduce manual effort. Document implemented controls, technical decisions, runbooks, operational procedures, and evidence required for audits, internal reviews, and continuous improvement of the security program. Technical Qualifications Required Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Strong practical experience in Microsoft 365 security, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and identity security controls. Hands-on experience with endpoint security management, including Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, device compliance, and security baselines. Practical experience with deploying, configuring, and operationalizing SIEM capabilities, including log source onboarding, data connector configuration, use case definition, alert tuning, and operational handover. Experience with KQL, detection logic, dashboards, workbooks, or security analytics rules. Understanding of vulnerability management, patching, secure configuration, and technical control implementation. Experience with scripting or automation, preferably using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or similar technologies. Skills & Abilities Required Ability to translate security risks, requirements, and audit findings into practical technical remediation actions. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate technical security issues independently. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with IT, R&D, and other stakeholders. Ability to clearly document implemented controls, technical decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.

title: Sales Development Representative - Europe

Product & track record Giskard provides the essential security & reliability layer to run AI agents with trust . Architected for critical AI systems, our platform helps enterprise AI & cybersecurity teams deploy AI agents that are not only powerful but actively defended against evolving threats . Key benefits include: Full-spectrum vulnerability coverage: Unifies Cybersecurity (OWASP), Safety (harmful content), and Business alignment (hallucinations) in one platform. Bank-Grade Security: SOC2/HIPAA/GDPR compliant architecture with Data Residency & Isolation, On-Premise options, RBAC, 0-training policy, and more. Proven at Scale: Trusted by global leaders in highly regulated sectors ( BNP Paribas, AXA, Société Générale, Michelin ) and AI pioneers (Mistral AI, Google DeepMind) to secure their most critical GenAI assets. → Learn more here . Backed by top-tier investors (Elaia, Bessemer Venture Partners, EIC Accelerator) and AI pioneers like the CTO of Hugging Face, we focus on actually useful technology that enables robust and secure innovation, not hype. Why this role As Giskard moves from Seed to Series A, we are scaling from strong early wins to a repeatable enterprise sales engine across Europe . Enterprise customers in banking, insurance, manufacturing, and other regulated industries already rely on us to secure their agentic AI initiatives, and demand for trusted AI security is accelerating. ​ In this role, you are on the front line of that growth: you will build pipeline, book qualified meetings with senior decision-makers, and open doors that lead to flagship enterprise deals. You will learn deeply about AI security, sharpen your craft on cutting‑edge outbound techniques, and grow your career alongside a European AI Security champion backed by top‑tier investors. Key responsibilities ​ Generate pipeline and book meetings: Own top-of-funnel activities to consistently book qualified meetings with target accounts across Europe, aligned with clear monthly and quarterly targets. ​ Run high-quality outbound: Design and execute multi-channel outbound sequences (email, LinkedIn, phone, events) to engage new prospects and revive dormant leads. ​ Cold calling & live conversations: Confidently pick up the phone, run discovery calls, and quickly qualify whether a prospect is a good fit for Giskard. ​ ​ Creative customer-centric communication: Craft original, thoughtful messages that stand out in crowded inboxes, adapting tone and content to technical decision-makers. ​ Learn deeply technical topics: Build a strong understanding of Giskard’s AI security and quality platform so you can confidently articulate the challenges of securing GenAI agents and the value we bring. ​ Collaborate with Sales & Product Marketing: Share insights from the field, refine ICP definitions, improve messaging, and contribute ideas for campaigns, content, and events. ​ Maintain data quality excellence: Keep all activities, contacts, opportunities and outreach campaigns cleanly documented to ensure reliable visibility into pipeline health and outreach performance. ​ Fluent in English and another European language (German, French, Spanish or another major European language); professional proficiency in both. ​ ​ Formal training in business development / sales development techniques , including cold calling, objection handling, qualification frameworks, and multi-channel outbound. ​ Hands-on experience using AI-powered qualification tools and sales automation platforms such as n8n, LaGrowthMachine, Lemlist, or Apollo (or similar). ​ Very creative communication skills : you know how to write messages and build sequences that get replies, and you are comfortable experimenting with new angles and formats. ​ Strong ability to learn quickly on deeply technical topics , ask the right questions, and translate complex AI and cybersecurity concepts into clear, simple value propositions. ​ Resilient, competitive, and goal-oriented mindset: you are motivated by targets, you track your own numbers, and you see each “no” as a learning opportunity. Strong ability to learn and execute quickly, with a coachable , feedback-driven mindset. ​ Experience with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and a data-driven approach to prioritizing accounts and activities. ​ Genuine curiosity about Generative AI, AI security, and how enterprises deploy GenAI agents in production. ​ Recruitment process Fit interview : 15 minutes. ​ Case study exercise, to be completed within 10 days. ​ Case study interview with role-play : 45 minutes. ​ ​ Final interview at the Paris office: 45 minutes.

title: Windows Systems Administrator
description: About The Role Imagine stepping into a place where every system you touch powers teams that are redefining aerospace and defence. As our Windows Systems Administrator, you will play a key role in managing, securing, and optimising a broad range of IT systems across the organisation. This role requires deep hands-on experience across Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, and related infrastructure, while maintaining a proactive security mindset. We are looking for someone who can ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of all systems supporting business operations. At Destinus, we are revolutionising the defence industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defence operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost-effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defence organisations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations. Join us in shaping the future of defence What You´ll Do Administration, monitoring, and optimization of Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Defender, Entra ID, Intune). Support and maintain Windows Server environments - Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file services, system patching, and backups. Manage endpoint devices via Intune and Autopilot, including policy configuration, compliance baselines, and device lifecycle management. Administer and customise Atlassian Jira and Confluence, ensuring alignment with team workflows and integrations. Apply security best practices across systems, ensuring compliance, monitoring, and incident response readiness. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across systems, cloud platforms, and applications. Provide consultation to IT support specialists on software and hardware configuration; assist in resolving complex incidents. Contribute to IT strategy discussions and propose improvements to enhance performance, security, and reliability of IT systems. Maintain accurate documentation of IT systems, configurations, and processes. What You’ll Need Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 5+ years in Windows systems administration with broad Microsoft platform exposure. Strong Windows Server and Active Directory skills (DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, DFS, replication). Strong Microsoft 365 administration skills, including identity, access control, automation, device management, monitoring, and incident resolution. Experience with automation and scripting using PowerShell. Understanding of virtualisation solutions (VMware / Hyper-V) and storage technologies. Deep understanding of OIDC, SAML 2.0, SCIM, and MFA flows; experience integrating SaaS platforms with Entra ID. Solid understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPNs). Familiarity with monitoring platforms (PRTG, SolarWinds, SIEM tools). Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and modern cybersecurity frameworks (ISO 27001, ABDO, NIS2). Certifications (Advantageous) Microsoft Certified - Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert or Azure Administrator Associate. Security+ or equivalent security-focused credential. MCSA / MCSE (Windows Server) or equivalent demonstrated experience. Who You Are You move fast, think sharp, and stay steady when things get complex. You love diving into Windows and Microsoft environments and solving problems across systems without getting boxed in. Ownership motivates you, collaboration fuels you, and security is always on your mind. You communicate clearly, act with integrity, and bring a proactive, improvement-driven mindset to everything you touch. You want to make real impact in a place where innovation is the everyday baseline.

title: SAP HANA Cloud developer - 6 Months Contract

Develop database artifacts including tables, views, procedures, functions, calculation views, and SQLScript. Build cloud-native applications using the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) . Develop RESTful APIs and integrate SAP HANA Cloud with SAP and third-party applications. Optimize database performance through indexing, partitioning, and query tuning. Implement data modeling, security, authorization, and role management. Develop and maintain ETL/data integration processes using SAP Integration Suite or SDI/SDA. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, code reviews, and testing. Collaborate with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions. Expertise in SQL, SQLScript, CDS Views , and database modeling. Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Hands-on experience with SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) . Strong knowledge of Node.js or Java for CAP development. Experience with SAP Fiori/UI5 (preferred). Experience with Git , CI/CD , and DevOps practices. Knowledge of SAP Datasphere or SAP Analytics Cloud. Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA integration. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or Cloud Foundry. Exposure to SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Build Apps. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. SAP certifications in SAP HANA Cloud or SAP BTP are preferred

title: Insider Risk Program Coordinator
description: A global bank headquartered in Europe is seeking an Insider Risk Program Coordinator to help drive the success of the Bank’s Insider Risk Management Program. Working as part of the team and reporting into Insider Risk program lead, this role will ensure high-quality policy, process, workflow, investigative, and analytical deliverables, and serve as the primary referent for the Bank’s program. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in insider risk technologies (especially analytic technologies such as UEBA systems and data protection controls), processes, regulatory standards, investigations, cybersecurity, and team management, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders across multiple functions. This experience should include knowledge of and experience with EU Works Councils’ expectations and processes. The ideal candidate will also have experience in a European Global Systemically Important Financial Institution, having served in a cybersecurity, enterprise security, or financial crimes/fraud management role. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: - Support development, coordination, socialization, and implementation of an enterprise operating model with supporting policies, processes, technology integration, and workflows for preventing, detecting, investigating, and mitigating insider risks. - Support development and implementation of insider risk technology platforms, especially but not limited to design and deployment of a UEBA platform. - Advise and support management of metrics, KPIs and report enhancements to measure the effectiveness of the program. - Ensure insider threat detection, analysis, and mitigation strategies align with the Firm's overall security and compliance objectives. - Coordinate efforts with the Firm’s cybersecurity, security, HR, legal, compliance, threat management and risk management teams, to develop proactive insider threat prevention and detection strategies. - Continuously assess and enhance insider risk methodologies, workflows, and technologies to optimize effectiveness. - Produce regular high-quality briefings, reports, and recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders. - Maintain strict confidentiality and professionalism in all operational and advisory activities. Essential - Bachelor’s degree in a related field. - 6+ years of experience in cyber and information security, with extensive hands-on experience in insider threat, incident response, threat hunting, and/or forensic analysis. - 2+ years of demonstrated experience in insider risk management-related technologies, especially UEBA, data analytics, writing detection signatures, or enhancing SIEM/SOC processes. - Experience and knowledge of the European financial services regulatory environment. - Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and behavioural analytics. - Excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Preferred - 5+ years of experience in a global systemically important financial institution. - Experience developing and producing Legitimate Interest Assessments and Data Protection Impact Assessments in support of EU and Work Council regulatory compliance. - Advanced industry certifications, such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, or equivalent. Solutions focussed - AI-native User Entity Behavioural Analytics - SIEM / SOAR platforms - Data analytics platforms - Data Loss Prevention - Identity and Access Management - Network Segmentation Client-centric - Uses own and wider knowledge and contributes to others to enable and make sound judgements that impact the client and team - Anticipates client needs and addresses these - Provides the best possible services to clients, ensuring the client is at the heart of everything we do One Firm - Builds strong relationships thought common goals, individual contribution and support in times of need - Considers the regional and global implications of what we do in our own areas of responsibility or team/department

title: Account Executive - Netherlands
description: Account Executive Location: Netherlands Reporting to: Regional Sales Director, Northern Europe Genetec - Protect the everyday We are a global Canadian company with a broad solutions portfolio that encompasses security, intelligence, and operations. We serve customers within a wide range of industries including transportation, education, and government. At Genetec we embrace open communication, creativity, and continuous learning to allow everyone to flourish in their own unique career paths. Our network of over 2,300 people globally comprises diverse individuals who are passionate about their work and open to new ideas. We prioritize the success and well-being of our employees. Discover Genetec's work environment and lively culture in this video - here . This role focuses on creating demand directly with enterprise and public-sector end users, influencing project specifications early, and supporting partners and system integrators through successful delivery and expansion opportunities. The Account Executive owns the territory strategy, builds strategic customer relationships, and drives complex solution sales aligned with Genetec’s unified security platform. Key Responsibilities Territory Ownership & Strategy Develop and execute a clear territory plan aligned with regional priorities and growth targets. Identify strategic verticals and key accounts within the Netherlands market. Build long-term account plans focused on pipeline generation, account expansion, and customer retention. Maintain strong visibility into project pipelines and market opportunities. End-User Development Engage directly with enterprise and public-sector end users to understand operational and security challenges. title: Endpoint & Microsoft 365 Security Engineer (Ghent)

This is a hands-on role focused on protecting user devices, collaboration platforms and communication technologies by ensuring that security controls are correctly configured, effectively monitored and continuously improved. The role combines technical engineering with operational security ownership. You will review security configurations, identify weaknesses and risky exceptions, coordinate remediation activities and provide clear visibility into the organisation’s endpoint, Microsoft 365 and email security posture. This is a remote-first position, with occasional travel to company offices when required. You will collaborate with Workplace Technology, IT Operations, Security Operations, business stakeholders, external vendors and specialist service providers. Maintaining and improving endpoint security baselines, including endpoint protection, EDR/XDR health, vulnerability scanning, device telemetry, patching and update compliance. Investigating and coordinating the remediation of devices that are degraded, non-compliant or no longer reporting correctly. Managing or supporting organisational controls for permitted and prohibited applications. Operating and enhancing Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security controls, particularly Conditional Access, device compliance, privileged access and local administrator protection. Supporting Microsoft Purview security and compliance capabilities, including information protection, Data Loss Prevention, audit, eDiscovery and retention-related controls. Working with privacy and compliance stakeholders to ensure that relevant Purview controls are appropriately implemented and maintained. Managing or providing strong operational support for Microsoft 365 and Mimecast email security controls. Reviewing and improving anti-spoofing, spam, phishing, attachment handling, impersonation and Business Email Compromise protections. Maintaining email authentication and reporting controls, including DMARC, DKIM, SPF and user phishing-reporting processes. Identifying and resolving email security assessment findings, configuration gaps and inappropriate exceptions in collaboration with internal teams and external specialists. Establishing practical operating procedures, dashboards, control evidence, KPIs and continuous improvement actions for endpoint, Microsoft 365 and email security. Using security incidents, phishing trends, audit observations, assessment results and user experience issues to develop sustainable improvements to security controls. Documenting remediation activities, assigning clear ownership and ensuring that actions are supported by appropriate evidence. At least five years of relevant security engineering or operational security experience within enterprise environments. Practical experience configuring, governing, reviewing or assessing endpoint and Microsoft 365 security controls. Strong hands-on knowledge of endpoint security, endpoint hardening, EDR/XDR, endpoint telemetry and patch or update compliance. Experience working with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Intune, including device compliance and the monitoring of endpoint security health. Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID security, particularly Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication, device posture, privileged access, audit logging and secure access governance. Good understanding of Microsoft 365 email security and secure email gateway controls. Experience with anti-spoofing, phishing and spam protection, attachment policies, impersonation and Business Email Compromise controls. Knowledge of DMARC, DKIM, SPF, phishing-reporting processes, exception handling and safe links or safe attachments concepts. Familiarity with Microsoft Purview capabilities, including information protection, Data Loss Prevention, audit, eDiscovery and retention concepts. Experience using administrative and investigation tools such as Microsoft Defender portal, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra admin centre and Exchange admin centre. Familiarity with Mimecast administration or comparable secure email gateway technology. Direct Mimecast experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, KQL or similar security monitoring and investigation tools. Familiarity with vulnerability scanning or vulnerability management platforms such as Qualys. Experience working with ServiceNow or similar platforms for incident management, exception handling and remediation tracking. Ability to produce and maintain meaningful security reports and dashboards using tools such as Excel or Power BI. Strong ability to review technical configurations, identify weak controls, bypasses or risky exceptions and convert findings into structured remediation plans. Experience with operational governance, evidence collection, security exception management, incident or alert handover and remediation follow-up. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, vendors and business stakeholders. Ability to balance security requirements with operational constraints and user experience considerations. Relevant security or Microsoft certifications are desirable but not mandatory. Own the end-to-end Vulnerability Management lifecycle for infrastructure and cloud assets, including scope definition, asset discovery, scanning coverage, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking, verification, exception management and reporting. Contribute to the accurate and complete documentation of assets within Asset Management and CMDB platforms. Review security-relevant technical changes and support infrastructure and cloud risk assessments. Translate identified risks into clear remediation actions, accountable owners and realistic target dates. Support investigations involving infrastructure, cloud or configuration-related security issues. Work with internal technical teams, suppliers and service providers to drive corrective actions and improve security maturity. At least 5 years of relevant experience within enterprise IT environments. Hands-on experience in infrastructure security, cloud security engineering or a closely related security role. Practical experience securing Microsoft Azure and AWS environments. Familiarity with hybrid infrastructure, Windows and Linux servers, networking and security appliances. Strong knowledge of Vulnerability Management, including: Asset and scanning coverage Authenticated vulnerability assessments Finding validation Risk-based prioritisation Asset and remediation owner identification Remediation tracking Exception management Verification and reporting Demonstrable experience identifying and remediating cloud vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses in collaboration with infrastructure, cloud and operational teams. Strong understanding of Secure Configuration Management, hardening principles and security baselines. Experience developing or applying secure configurations for: Windows and Linux servers Azure and AWS services Network and security infrastructure Privileged remote-access tools Internet-facing systems Exposure to security and IT service management tools such as Qualys, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, ServiceNow or comparable platforms. Good understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIS2, CyFun, CIS Benchmarks and secure-by-design principles. Ability to interpret technical security findings and clearly communicate the related business risk, required actions, ownership and remediation timelines. Confidence working with infrastructure teams, cloud engineers, network specialists, architects, security teams, suppliers and external partners. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and drive issues through to resolution. Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining effective collaboration across technical and business teams. Experience supporting security assessments, audits, technical risk reviews or evidence-gathering activities.
